v1.2.1.title: TXATOOL - WIN - Changelog v1.2.1
content: Completely resolved blank screen issue when opening 'Fix Game Errors & Turbo' or 'Game Configs FPS' views (fixed NullReferenceException during InitializeComponent).
Fixed duplicate desktop shortcuts created during updater/installer overwrite.
Streamlined seamless navigation directly from Dashboard to Gaming Optimization tools.
Synchronized version v1.2.1 across entire app ecosystem, Settings, and auto-update channels.

v1.2.0.title: TXATOOL - WIN - Changelog v1.2.0
v1.2.0.summary_title: OFFICIAL UPDATE v1.2.0 (HYPER GAMING & TURBO BOOST)
content: Activated official Game Doctor & Gaming Optimization suite inspired by HyperLis.
Added Turbo Boost & Pro Tools Dock on Dashboard: Instant RAM working sets & standby list purging, DNS/Temp flush, and quick launch for TimerResolution (0.5ms), MSI Util v3, NV Inspector, RAMMap.
Activated Fix Game Errors view: Fix FPS stutters (MMCSS Priority), GPU driver crashes, and clean DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD shader caches.
Integrated live Secure Boot & TPM 2.0 diagnostics, with guided repairs for Valorant VAN 9003 and anti-cheat errors.
Activated Game Configs & Presets: Custom optimized profiles for Delta Force (Hawks Ops), CS2, PUBG, and Battlefield with 1-click auto-detect, backup, and restore.
Integrated automatic checking and installation for Visual C++ All-in-One Redistributables and DirectX Runtimes.
Enhanced Fluent Design responsiveness and performance.

v1.1.0.title: TXATOOL - WIN - Changelog v1.1.0
content: Integrated official command-line TXA Package Manager (txapm): install, uninstall, health check doctor, and dedicated terminal.
Added advanced system tuning & optimization suite: NTLite (auto-download & run), RAMMap64 (clear RAM), NVIDIA Profile Inspector, Chris Titus WinUtil, MSI Util v3, Timer Resolution.
Brand new NSIS installer: Multilingual (Vietnamese & English), Fluent Dark Blue styling with glowing tech banners.
Smart upgrade & overwrite mechanism: Automatic conflict handling and safe in-place overwrite mode.
Integrated auto-update ecosystem powered by txa.yml format.
Dedicated VietQR donation card & popup supporting TXA.
Distinct routing for Software Store (txavl.github.io/txa-repo) and Documentation (txavl.github.io/txa-repo/docs/).

v1.0.0.title: TXATOOL - WIN - Changelog v1.0.0
content: Initial official release of TXATOOL - WIN toolkit for IT technicians and power users.
Integrated WSAP: Automated Windows installation directly from ISO image into HDD partition without USB Boot.
Comprehensive Network LAN printer repair suite (fixing 0x0000011b, 0x00000709, 0x0000007c, RPC, and Firewall issues).
Windows Edition Switcher (Convert SKUs) between Home, Pro, Enterprise, IoT Enterprise LTSC.
Smart licensing manager: activation check, digital license backup and restore.
Deep OS performance optimization: disabling telemetry, reducing latency, RAM optimization, and disk cleanup.
UWP bloatware remover and Windows startup manager.
Curated app store with essential tools updated regularly.
Customizable Microsoft Office deployment tool.
Modern Fluent Glass UI with automatic Light/Dark system theme matching and full Vietnamese / English localization.
